entry.title: New: Resolution 95 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO ENTER INTO NEGOTIATIONS FOR THE ACQUISITION OF ALL OR A PORTION OF THE PROPERTIES IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS: 2-7-011:001 AND 2-7-010:027, SITUATED IN THE AHUPUAʻA OF KAWAINUI AND ONOMEA, DISTRICT OF SOUTH HILO, UTILIZING THE PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION FUND

The County seeks to acquire approximately 81.19 acres of land to protect and preserve cultural and natural resources and open certain areas of the property for educational, gathering, and cultural practices. The parcel is listed as priority number two in the 2024 Annual Report of the Public Access, Open Space, and Natural Resources Preservation Commission.
